evidenceLevelNow: MOCKED (local fork rehearsal) + PUBLIC_READ_ONLY verification; no public execution has happened
evidenceLevelAfterOwnerAction: TESTNET_EXECUTED only if the owner signs, the transactions land, Flofi reconciles them, the bundle is archived and the independent verifier passes
authority: Only the owner signs, in the owner's own browser wallet, through Flofi's reviewed wallet flow. Flofi holds no key, never signs, never sends, never retries a transaction.

network.name: Ethereum Sepolia
network.wrongNetworks: Ethereum Mainnet (0x1) and Base Sepolia (0x14a34) fail closed; Flofi never switches to or adds Mainnet.

wallet.kind: The owner's own injected browser wallet (e.g. MetaMask) on Ethereum Sepolia
accepted: A direct EOA transaction from the owner
A MetaMask Delegation Framework redemption of exactly the reviewed call (EIP-7702), whose DelegationManager/EIP7702StatelessDeleGator code matches the Ethereum Sepolia pins

app.local: GRYLOO_SUPPLY_JOURNAL=<durable dir> (no harness variable) runs the Supply service against public Ethereum Sepolia with PUBLIC_TESTNET provenance
app.authoring: Build → Add supply → Supply network: Ethereum Sepolia → amount 0.001 WBTC → beneficiary: the connected owner → Simulate → Review → Execute

prerequisites.how: Any public Sepolia faucet to the owner address
prerequisites.bound: The Review shows the exact fee upper bound; ≥ 0.005 test ETH is ample at current Sepolia gas prices

prerequisites.how: Aave's permissionless testnet faucet, owner-signed, outside Flofi (app.aave.com testnet mode, or the call below)
prerequisites.note: Setup only, not evidence. Flofi never sends it.

prerequisites.expect: status READ_ONLY_SIMULATION_VERIFIED, with the exact calls and gas limits for that owner

transactions.condition: Only if the owner's current WBTC allowance to the Pool is below 100000 (Review shows whether it is required)

gas.note: Flofi sets the limit from the simulation at Review; the wallet must not raise it

transactions.calldataRule: Replace <OWNER_ADDRESS_LEFT_PADDED_TO_32_BYTES> with the owner address left-padded to 32 bytes; the result must equal the wallet prompt byte for byte

nonce.rule: The wallet assigns the nonce; Flofi records the owner's pending nonce at Review, reserves it under the chain-qualified lease eip155-11155111-<owner>-<nonce>, and accepts only a transaction with that nonce.
nonce.uncertain: If the wallet response is lost or ambiguous, Flofi observes by hash and by nonce; it never resends. A replaced or cancelled transaction is reconciled, never retried blindly.

expiry.review: expiresAt = simulation time + 120 s; an expired, edited or chain-changed Review cannot reach the wallet and needs a new simulation and Review
expiry.walletNetwork: eth_chainId is re-read before each wallet request; anything other than 0xaa36a7 stops before signing

supply.aWbtc: 0x1804bf30507dc2eb3bdebbbdd859991eaef6eeff position +100000 units (scaled balance at the post-block liquidity index; bounded ray rounding)
supply.allowance: consumed back to its prior value
supply.collateral: reserve id 3 collateral bit (userConfiguration 0x80) set on first supply
supply.nativeCost: gasUsed × effectiveGasPrice only; an Ethereum L1 receipt carries no l1Fee (a receipt with l1Fee fails closed)

postTransactionVerification: Flofi observes each receipt, requires canonical inclusion on 0xaa36a7, the exact reviewed to/data/value from the owner (or a pinned MetaMask redemption of exactly that call), and reconciles WBTC, aWBTC, allowance, collateral and cost; verdict must be RECONCILED.
Download the Evidence Bundle (environment TESTNET_EXECUTED, outcome RECONCILED) and archive it.
node scripts/verify-ethereum-sepolia-supply.mjs --evidence <bundle.json> verification.json → status TESTNET_EXECUTED, verdict INDEPENDENTLY_RECONCILED.

followOn.note: After Supply reconciles, the same flow authors Borrow, Repay and Withdraw of WBTC on Ethereum Sepolia (rehearsed on the fork: Borrow 0.0001, Repay 0.00005, Withdraw 0.0002 WBTC). Each needs its own Review and owner signature; the independent verifier covers Supply only.

stopConditions: Wallet on any chain other than 0xaa36a7
Any wallet prompt whose to, data or value differs from this package
Any Flofi verdict other than RECONCILED
